description: This Go source file defines functions that handle translation and processing of documentation files with frontmatter markup, including reading, parsing, translating via an external translator, updating frontmatter, and saving the translated content.

methods.name: processFileDoc
methods.description: Main function that reads a documentation file, translates its content by replacing frontmatter and body with translated versions, and saves the result.

methods.name: formatTaggedDocument
methods.description: Formats frontmatter and body into a tagged document with specific start and end tags.

methods.name: parseTaggedDocument
methods.description: Parses a tagged document into frontmatter and body components.

methods.name: trimTagNewlines
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing newlines from a string.

methods.name: buildFrontmatterTemplate
methods.description: Builds a frontmatter template string with placeholders for translation, returning markers for placeholders.

methods.name: markerPair
methods.description: Returns start and end markers for a given frontmatter field and index.

methods.name: applyFrontmatterTranslations
methods.description: Applies translated frontmatter values to the original frontmatter data structure.

methods.name: extractMarkerValue
methods.description: Extracts the value enclosed between specific start and end markers in a text.

methods.name: setReadWhenValue
methods.description: Establishes or updates a specific index in the read_when list with a new value.

methods.name: shouldSkipDoc
methods.description: Determines whether a document should be skipped based on stored source hash comparison.

methods.name: extractSourceHash
methods.description: Extracts the source hash value from frontmatter data.

methods.name: resolveDocsPath
methods.description: Resolves absolute and relative paths for documentation files ensuring they are within the docs root.
